nodes.label: Cvar-gated default-off seam
nodes.rationale: kbot features are wired into stock KTX Frogbot as additive KBot_* calls, each behind a master k_kbot_* cvar defaulting 0 (bit-identical vanilla) plus a per-bot fb.kbot flag. Chosen over editing frogbot logic in place so every feature is independently A/B-testable on the bench and the fork stays a reviewable superset of upstream KTX with cheap merges.

nodes.label: Trick jumps active on master
nodes.rationale: Discrete scripted gapjump lanes (GJ_* engine in kbot_main.c) are reachability edges that fire only when no enemy is watching, so they don't contend with combat for the load-bearing movement channel; kept as first-class capability, reverse-engineered from human MVDs.

nodes.label: Bunnyhop paused
nodes.rationale: Continuous strafe-jump speed as a movement mode is parked on feat/kbot-* branches (not deleted). Lessons 6 & 8 (KomodoBench findings-log + artifacts/records/speed-gate.json): naive bunny and the decoupled carve-motor each cost ~25-32 frags because the movement channel is load-bearing for combat; not reopened without a fundamentally different navigation stack.

nodes.label: discipline veto
nodes.rationale: Zeros a kbot's hunt-desire when under-stacked (weak), sending it to collect instead of fight. Only negative fight selection helps; enemy-seeking loses.
